data.name: Ermelinda
data.gender_notes: Ermelinda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'ermen' (whole, entire) and 'lindus' (gentle, kind), symbolizing a serene and gentle strength. The name Ermelinda carries the meaning “Serene, gentle strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ermelinda usually hope their child will grow to embody serene, gentle strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of steadfast faith and grace
data.etymology: Ermelinda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Serene, gentle strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ermelinda total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.spiritual_significance: Ermelinda is a name that represents wholeness and kindness in the spiritual realm. It encourages individuals to be strong in their faith, gentle in their actions, and kind in their hearts. The name Ermelinda is a reminder of the importance of embracing the divine wholesomeness within oneself, and striving to be a beacon of love and compassion to others. It is a name that inspires spiritual growth, exploring the depths of faith, and cultivating a deep connection to the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ermelinda, derived from the Old German name Hermelindis, means "helper of the world" or "whole earth." This name symbolizes the idea of being a beacon of hope and assistance to others, embodying the Christian virtues of compassion and selflessness. In spiritual terms, Ermelinda represents the divine feminine, a nurturing and healing force that brings balance and harmony to the world.
